title: AuthProvider contract violation deferred to WS path only
description: The AuthProvider doc comment already notes this but it is a trap: violations cause a panic in connect_ws (HeaderName/HeaderValue conversion) but are silently tolerated on all HTTP paths (header is passed as &str to reqwest which silently rejects invalid values in some versions or panics in others). A custom AuthProvider returning a header name with spaces will fail differently on HTTP vs WS paths, making the contract hard to test. The contract is documented; the risk is that it is not enforced uniformly. No immediate fix needed but the doc should be stronger: 'violating this contract causes a panic on the WebSocket path and undefined behavior on HTTP paths'.
